rubric.evidence: Re-checked against w3c.github.io/container-timing (CG draft 1 Oct 2026; the wicg.github.io URL now redirects there) and Chromium main performance_container_timing.idl + html_element.idl. Corrected four pre-upgrade errors: size is the total painted-region area (spec 6.14), not the largest element's area; lastPaintedElement is the largest-new-area contributor in the frame (6.13 note); the warn-block flag '#container-timing' replaced with #enable-experimental-web-platform-features (ChromeStatus flag_name + BCD) / --enable-blink-features=ContainerTiming; Firefox/Safari 'No position' replaced with Positive (mozilla #1155) / Neutral (WebKit #442) from the ChromeStatus record. Severity records the pre-upgrade errors.
Feature 5110962817073152 listed under 'Origin trial' in chromestatus milestone=148 (queried 2026-11-15); OT stage desktop/android 148-153. Route and identity unchanged; manifest demo unchanged.

Verbatim IDL now in #idl; the contract inventory grew from 8 to 15 items to cover every declared member (intersectionRect, rootElement, paintTime, presentationTime, toJSON, name/duration, containertimingignore). check-conformance: declared 11 = inventory 11 + outOfScope 0. Overview-only (no child routes); members are simple read-only getters.

New #lifecycle subsection summarises spec 6.5-6.9: registration on connect, at most one entry per root per frame, any region growth queues an entry, recording stops after scroll/input, nested-root propagation and ignore semantics.

Existing PerformanceObserver examples kept; added containertimingignore markup example from spec 3.1 and the live content-section-timer showcase embed. Examples not executed against a flagged Chrome 148 build.

Prose-only support table replaced with BCD api/PerformanceContainerTiming.json + api/HTMLElement.json data (fetched raw 2026-11-15): Chrome 145 flag, Edge mirror, Firefox 156 pref dom.enable_container_timing, Safari false; OT 148-153 labelled interim from ChromeStatus. Baseline banner: webstatus.dev container-timing = limited.

All new links curl-checked 200 on 2026-11-15 except github.com URLs (BCD blob pages, standards-positions issues, WICG explainer), which return 403 through the session proxy; their content was verified via raw BCD JSON and the ChromeStatus record. Existing mail-archive intent links left as-is.
Baseline banner role=note aria-label; tables keep thead/th; iframe has title + figcaption with a text link to the demo; single h1; new h2 #security-and-privacy and h3 ids.

Playwright headless Chrome 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3: scrollWidth == innerWidth on both, zero console errors, zero failed requests. Compat/property tables use page-local nowrap name columns (fixing squeezed 2-char columns seen in the first desktop screenshot); mobile tables scroll inside .table-wrap. Screenshots: scratchpad ct-desktop.png, ct-mobile.png, ct-*-compat.png, ct-*-banner.png, ct-desktop-iframe.png.

Feature route and all five concept routes returned 200 on 2026-11-15. content-section-timer embedded after a text link to the feature index so the manifest's selected demo URL stays https://chrome-platform-showcase.paulkinlan-ea.deno.net/v148/container-timing/ (verified with deno task manifest; check-routes PASS, no migration). iframe loaded with title 'Content Section Timer — Container Timing — Chrome 148'.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table on mobile without horizontal page overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep semantic table/thead/th markup and let the table scroll in a wrapper on small screens instead of crushing columns below legibility.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: compat and property tables keep thead/th inside the existing .table-wrap scroller; name/version columns no longer break mid-token, and the notes column gets a min-width on narrow screens so it scrolls instead of shrinking. Exception: no sticky headers or stacked layout, to stay consistent with the shared v148 table pattern.

guidanceConsulted.query: lazy loading cross-origin iframe embed sandbox
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use native loading="lazy" for below-the-fold iframes and give them explicit dimensions to avoid layout shift.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: the showcase iframe is loading="lazy" with width/height attributes, placed well below the fold in Examples.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use semantic HTML and give landmark-like regions an accessible name; do not rely on colour alone.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: banner is role=note with aria-label="Baseline status"; limited browsers are marked by text ('not supported', 'behind a pref') as well as dashed borders.

openQuestions: Chromium IDL differs from the spec on two types (size: double vs unsigned long long; lastPaintedElement: Element? vs HTMLElement?). The page states both; which one Chrome 148 shipped was not checked at a pinned 148 revision.
